svg.title: A newborn boy is scheduled for circumcision, and the nurse is teaching the parents about the procedure and the care that follows. Which actions are correct? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: Voiding is verified beforehand, petroleum jelly at every diaper change keeps the diaper from sticking, and bleeding that continues for 24 hours is a complication to report. Removing the yellow crust is the tempting wrong answer, since it is normal healing and is left alone, and feedings are never withheld.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
The Normal Newborn &
Thermoregulation
Read the situation
A newborn boy is scheduled for
circumcision, and the nurse is teaching
the parents about the procedure and the
care that follows. Which actions are
correct? Select all that apply.
What fits here
Confirm that the newborn has voided before
the procedure · Apply petroleum jelly to
the site at every diaper change · Notify
the provider if bleeding continues for 24
hours
Why it fits
Voiding is verified beforehand, petroleum
jelly at every diaper change keeps the
diaper from sticking, and bleeding that
continues for 24 hours is a complication
to report.
